title: Chapter 9 Quiz: Microservices Basics
description: Test your knowledge of microservices architecture, service discovery, API gateway, and inter‑service communication.

questions.question: What is a key advantage of microservices over a monolith?
questions.explanation: Microservices allow each service to be scaled independently based on its load.

questions.question: In a microservices architecture, all services must use the same programming language.
questions.explanation: Polyglot persistence and language choice are allowed; each service can be built with the most suitable technology.

questions.question: The service registry used by Spring Cloud is called _________.
questions.explanation: Netflix Eureka is the default service registry in Spring Cloud (though others can be used).

questions.question: Which annotation enables a Spring Boot application as a Eureka server?
questions.explanation: @EnableEurekaServer turns the application into a Eureka server.

questions.question: Feign clients allow you to make HTTP requests in a declarative, interface‑based way.
questions.explanation: Feign abstracts HTTP calls into Java interfaces annotated with Spring MVC annotations.

questions.question: What is the purpose of an API Gateway?
options: To act as a single entry point for clients
questions.explanation: API Gateway provides a unified entry point, handling routing, security, and cross‑cutting concerns.

questions.question: In Spring Cloud Gateway, the URI prefix _________ indicates that service discovery should be used to locate the service.
questions.explanation: lb:// tells the gateway to look up the service via service discovery (load‑balanced).

questions.question: Which Spring Cloud component is used to implement circuit breakers?
questions.explanation: Both Resilience4j and the now‑maintenance‑mode Hystrix can be used; Resilience4j is the modern choice.

questions.question: In a microservices environment, it's common for each service to have its own database.
questions.explanation: Decentralized data management is a core principle; services typically own their data schema.

questions.question: What does the @FeignClient annotation require to locate the target service?
questions.explanation: Feign uses the service name (e.g., 'user-service') which is resolved via service discovery.

questions.question: The default port for the Eureka server dashboard is _________.
questions.explanation: Eureka server runs on port 8761 by default.

questions.question: Which of the following is a synchronous communication method?
questions.explanation: HTTP/REST is synchronous; message queues and event streams are asynchronous.

questions.question: Spring Cloud Gateway is built on the reactive stack (WebFlux).
questions.explanation: It uses Project Reactor and Netty for non‑blocking I/O.

questions.question: What is the role of the `@EnableDiscoveryClient` annotation?
options: It enables service discovery for the application (registers with registry)
It creates a new Eureka server
It is no longer needed in modern Spring Cloud
questions.explanation: In recent Spring Cloud versions, adding the Eureka client starter automatically enables discovery; `@EnableDiscoveryClient` is optional but can be used to be explicit.

questions.question: The Spring Cloud project that provides a declarative REST client is _________.
questions.explanation: Spring Cloud OpenFeign integrates Feign with Spring Boot and service discovery.

questions.question: What is a typical pattern to handle failures when one microservice calls another?
questions.explanation: Resilience patterns like circuit breakers, retries, and timeouts help build fault‑tolerant systems.

questions.question: API Gateway can also handle authentication and rate limiting.
questions.explanation: Yes, these are common cross‑cutting concerns handled at the gateway layer.

questions.question: In the context of microservices, what does 'bounded context' refer to?
options: The specific business domain a service owns
questions.explanation: A bounded context is a logical boundary where a particular model is defined and applicable.

questions.question: The annotation to enable Feign clients is _________.
questions.explanation: Place @EnableFeignClients on a configuration class to scan for @FeignClient interfaces.

questions.question: Why is service discovery essential in a dynamic microservices environment?
options: Because IP addresses change due to auto‑scaling and failures
questions.explanation: Service discovery dynamically locates service instances whose addresses may change over time.
